claim_text: [正文·作者原文] nanochat 是面向单 GPU 节点的极简 LLM 训练 harness，覆盖 tokenization/pretraining/finetuning/evaluation/inference 全部主要阶段。
quote: nanochat is the simplest experimental harness for training LLMs. It is designed to run on a single GPU node, the code is minimal/hackable, and it covers all major LLM stages including tokenization, pretraining, finetuning, evaluation, and inference.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 参考成本与时长：GPT-2 能力级 LLM 2019 年训练约 $43,000，如今 8×H100 节点约 2 小时、$48；spot 实例可低至约 $15。
quote: you can train your own GPT-2 capability LLM (which cost ~$43,000 to train in 2019) for only $48 (~2 hours of 8XH100 GPU node) and then talk to it over a simple CLI. On a spot instance, the total cost can be closer to ~$15.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 方法机制只有一个复杂度旋钮 `--depth`（transformer 层数）；GPT-2 能力对应约 depth 26。
quote: nanochat is configured out of the box to train an entire miniseries of compute-optimal models by setting one single complexity dial: `--depth`, the number of layers in the GPT transformer model (GPT-2 capability happens to be approximately depth 26).

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 其余超参（transformer 宽度、头数、学习率调整、训练时长、weight decay 等）由系统自动按最优方式计算。
quote: All other hyperparameters (the width of the transformer, number of heads, learning rate adjustments, training horizons, weight decays, ...) are calculated automatically in an optimal way.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 榜单口径：GPT-2 speedrun = 训练到 GPT-2 能力级所需的墙钟时间，以 DCLM CORE 分数衡量。
quote: which is the wall-clock time required to train a nanochat model to GPT-2 grade capability, as measured by the DCLM CORE score.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 主指标 = 在 8×H100 节点上跑赢 GPT-2（1.6B）CORE 所需墙钟；GPT-2 的 CORE 分数为 0.256525。
quote: the wall clock time needed to outperform the GPT-2 (1.6B) CORE metric on an 8XH100 GPU node. The GPT-2 CORE score is 0.256525.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 价格基准约 $3/GPU/hr → 8×H100 节点约 $24/hr → 2 小时约 $48；作者称现已远低于 $100。
quote: at the current ~$3/GPU/hr, an 8XH100 node is ~$24/hr, so 2 hours is ~$48

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 整条流水线收敛在单一脚本 `runs/speedrun.sh`，其设计目标是 8×H100 GPU 节点。
quote: The entire pipeline to do so is contained in the single file [runs/speedrun.sh](runs/speedrun.sh), which is designed to be run on an 8XH100 GPU node.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] speedrun 一次运行耗时约 1.5 小时。
quote: this will take ~1.5 hours to run

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] speedrun 模型是 4e19 FLOPs 的能力模型。
quote: The speedrun is a 4e19 FLOPs capability model

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 代码在 Ampere 8×A100 节点上同样可以正常跑，只是稍慢。
quote: - The code will run just fine on the Ampere 8XA100 GPU node as well, but a bit slower.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 单卡可跑：去掉 `torchrun` 即自动切换梯度累积，结果 ~identical，墙钟要慢 8 倍。
quote: All code will run just fine on even a single GPU by omitting `torchrun`, and will produce ~identical results (code will automatically switch to gradient accumulation), but you'll have to wait 8 times longer.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 显存不足 80GB 时下调 `--device-batch-size`（默认 32 → 16/8/4/2/1）。
quote: Look for `--device-batch-size` in the scripts and reduce it until things fit. E.g. from 32 (default) to 16, 8, 4, 2, or even 1.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 快速实验档：12 层（GPT-1 规模）预训练约 5 分钟。
quote: For quick experimentation (~5 min pretraining runs) my favorite scale is to train a 12-layer model (GPT-1 sized)

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 迭代监控指标含 `val_bpb`（以 bit/byte 计的验证损失），随 step、总训练时长与总 FLOPs 变化。
quote: `val_bpb` (validation loss in vocab-size-invariant units of bits per byte) as a function of `step`, `total_training_time` and `total_training_flops`.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 迭代监控指标含 `core_metric`（DCLM CORE 分数）。
quote: 2. `core_metric` (the DCLM CORE score)

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 以当前代码，GPT-2 能力模型落在 d24-d26 区间。
quote: GPT-2 capability model (which is of most interest at the moment) happens to be somewhere around d24-d26 range with the current code.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 任何候选改动都必须足够原则化，以保证对所有 depth 设置都成立。
quote: But any candidate changes to the repo have to be principled enough that they work for all settings of depth.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] CPU/MPS 脚本只作演示用途；材料明确说这样得不到强结果。

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] CUDA SM 80+（A100、H100 等）默认 dtype 为 bfloat16。

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 默认 dtype 可用 `NANOCHAT_DTYPE` 环境变量覆盖。

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] 混合精度实现：权重 fp32 存储以保优化器精度，`Linear` 层前向时转 COMPUTE_DTYPE，embedding 直接以 COMPUTE_DTYPE 存储。
quote: model weights are stored in fp32 (for optimizer precision), but our custom `Linear` layer casts them to `COMPUTE_DTYPE` during the forward pass. Embeddings are stored directly in `COMPUTE_DTYPE` to save memory.

claim_text: [正文·作者原文] fp16 训练会自动启用 GradScaler 防止梯度下溢；SFT 也支持 fp16，但 RL 当前不支持。
